# Servicem8

ServiceM8 helps field service businesses schedule jobs, send quotes, and manage invoices, offering staff mobile apps and real-time job status tracking

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/servicem8/.

## Actions

- **Create a new Job**: Create a new job in servicem8.
- **Delete Job Note**: Delete a specific job note.
- **List All Assets**: List all servicem8 assets.
- **List All Clients**: List all servicem8 clients.
- **List All Document Templates**: List document templates.
- **List All Forms**: List all servicem8 forms.
- **List All Job Notes** (read-only): List all job notes in servicem8.
- **List All Job Queues**: List all job queues in servicem8.
- **List All Jobs**: List all jobs.
- **List All Locations**: List all servicem8 locations.
- **List All Materials**: List all materials.
- **List All Tasks**: List all tasks in a servicem8 account.
- **Retrieve Form**: Retrieve details of a specific form by its uuid.
- **Retrieve Job**: Retrieve details of a specific job by its uuid.
- **Retrieve Job Activity**: Retrieve details of a specific job activity by its uuid.
- **Retrieve Job Note**: Retrieve details of a specific job note by its uuid.
- **Retrieve Job Payment**: Retrieve details of a specific job payment by its uuid.
- **Retrieve Job Queue**: Retrieve details of a specific job queue by its uuid.
- **Retrieve Location**: Retrieve details of a specific location by its uuid.
- **Retrieve ServiceM8 Client** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific client by its uuid.
- **Retrieve ServiceM8 Material**: Retrieve details of a specific material by its uuid.
- **Retrieve Staff Member**: Retrieve details of a specific staff member by their uuid.
- **ServiceM8 Create Job**: Create a new job in servicem8.
- **ServiceM8 Create Job Note**: Create a new job note in servicem8.
- **ServiceM8 Create Job Payment**: Create a new job payment in servicem8.
- **ServiceM8 Delete Job Payment**: Delete (archive) a specific job payment by its uuid.
- **ServiceM8 Update Job Payment**: Update details of an existing job payment.
- **Update a ServiceM8 Job Note**: Update details of an existing job note.
